title.zh: PetAssistant：我和 AI 做了一只 macOS 桌面猫
title.en: PetAssistant: building a desktop cat with AI

summary.zh: 从一张静态猫图开始，把日历、待办和语音放到桌面上。一份完整的项目记录：交互取舍、字幕调试，以及当前版本的边界。
summary.en: From a static cat to a calendar and to-do companion: the interaction decisions, caption debugging, and limits of the current version.
